mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_POST(POST_NO, POST_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER_NO, VIEW_COUNT, CREATED_AT, CATEGORY, STATUS) VALUES(SEQ_POST_NO.NEXTVAL, #{postType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writerNo}, #{viewCount}, SYSDATE, '자유', 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT B.POST_NO, B.TITLE, B.POST_TYPE, B.WRITER_NO, M.USER_NAME, B.CREATED_AT, B.CONTENT, F.FILE_NO, F.ORIGIN_NAME, F.SAVE_NAME, F.FILE_PATH FROM BOARD_POST B JOIN MEMBER M ON (B.WRITER_NO = M.USER_NO) LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT FILE_NO, TARGET_NO, ORIGIN_NAME, SAVE_NAME, FILE_PATH, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TARGET_NO ORDER BY FILE_NO DESC) as rn FROM FILE_ATTACHMENT ) WHERE rn = 1 ) F ON (B.POST_NO = F.TARGET_NO) WHERE B.POST_NO = #{postNo} AND B.STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_POST SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT +1 WHERE POST_NO = #{postNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM BOARD_POST WHERE POST_TYPE = #{postType} AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY POST_NO DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILE_ATTACHMENT(FILE_NO, TARGET_NO, TARGET_TYPE, ORIGIN_NAME, SAVE_NAME, FILE_PATH, CREATED_AT, STATUS) VALUES(SEQ_FNO.NEXTVAL, #{targetNo}, #{targetType}, #{originName}, #{saveName}, #{filePath}, SYSDATE, 'Y')
